name: slagent-i18n-hints
description: Shows react-i18next translations as inline editor hints from JSON or Rails YAML resources.

slagent.i18nHints.enabled.description: Show inline English translation hints for react-i18next calls.

slagent.i18nHints.locale.description: Locale used to read translation resources. Workspace settings can set this for the whole project.

slagent.i18nHints.resourcePath.description: Repository translation path template. Supports {{lng}} and {{ns}}, for example public/locales/{{lng}}/{{ns}}.json or config/locales/{{lng}}.yml.

slagent.i18nHints.defaultNamespace.description: Default translation namespace. If empty, the extension uses the i18next config or translation.

slagent.i18nHints.namespaces.description: Fallback namespaces when the i18next config does not declare them.
